en.meta.title: Vestra Player: a video player where every feature is a plugin
en.meta.description: Vestra Player is a desktop video player for Windows and macOS. Playback by libmpv, a native interface, and everything beyond playback is a plugin you can install, remove or write.
en.hero.title: Every feature is a plugin.
en.hero.lede: Vestra Player is a desktop video player for Windows and macOS. Playback by libmpv, a native interface, and everything beyond playback is a plugin you can install, remove or write.
en.hero.unsigned: Free test builds, not yet code-signed.
en.tour.label: Feature tour
en.hl.title: Highlights
en.hl.mpv.title: Playback by libmpv
en.hl.mpv.text: The engine behind mpv decodes and plays; the interface is native Slint, not a web page.
en.hl.plugins.title: Every feature is a plugin
en.hl.plugins.text: The playback bar, playlist, subtitles and even the store are TypeScript plugins on one public API, each in its own process.
en.hl.seek.title: See where you seek
en.hl.seek.text: Thumbnails on the seek bar, fast keyframe seeking and a playlist with thumbnails.
en.hl.open.title: Open licences
en.hl.open.text: The player is GPL-3.0-or-later; the plugin SDK and the plugin repository are Apache-2.0.
en.dl.title: Download
en.dl.lede: Choose the file for your system. All files of a release are listed on its release page.
en.dl.note.installer: Installs for your user only, without administrator rights. The build is not code-signed yet: if Windows SmartScreen warns, choose More info → Run anyway.
en.dl.note.portable: Unzip anywhere and run vestra-host.exe. Nothing is installed; SmartScreen may warn the same way as for the installer.
en.dl.note.dmg: Open the disk image and drag Vestra Player into Applications. The app is not notarized yet: on first launch macOS blocks it; open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
en.dl.fallback: Release details could not be loaded when this page was built. The release page has every file.
en.dl.verify: To check a download, compare its SHA-256 with the value here: certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256 on Windows, shasum -a 256 <file> on macOS.
en.ft.licence: Vestra Player is licensed under {player}. The plugin SDK and the plugin repository are licensed under {plugins}.
en.ft.credits: Footage and games in the demos
en.ft.privacy: No cookies, analytics or trackers. Your language choice is kept only in your browser.
en.ft.builtWith: Built on libmpv, Slint and Node.js.

zh-Hans.meta.title: Vestra Player：每个功能都是插件的视频播放器
zh-Hans.meta.description: Vestra Player 是一款适用于 Windows 和 macOS 的桌面视频播放器。由 libmpv 负责播放，界面原生；播放之外的一切都是插件，可以安装、移除，也可以自己写。
zh-Hans.hero.title: 每个功能都是插件。
zh-Hans.hero.lede: Vestra Player 是一款适用于 Windows 和 macOS 的桌面视频播放器。由 libmpv 负责播放，界面原生；播放之外的一切都是插件，可以安装、移除，也可以自己写。
zh-Hans.hero.other: 其他下载、校验值和系统要求
zh-Hans.hero.unsigned: 免费测试版，暂未进行代码签名。
zh-Hans.tour.label: 功能导览
zh-Hans.hl.title: 亮点
zh-Hans.hl.mpv.title: libmpv 负责播放
zh-Hans.hl.mpv.text: 由 mpv 背后的引擎解码和播放；界面使用原生 Slint，而不是网页。
zh-Hans.hl.plugins.title: 每个功能都是插件
zh-Hans.hl.plugins.text: 播放控制栏、播放列表、字幕，甚至插件商城本身，都是基于同一套公开 API 的 TypeScript 插件，各自运行在独立进程中。
zh-Hans.hl.seek.title: 拖动进度条，所见即所得
zh-Hans.hl.seek.text: 进度条缩略图预览、快速关键帧跳转，播放列表也带缩略图。
zh-Hans.hl.open.title: 开放许可
zh-Hans.hl.open.text: 播放器采用 GPL-3.0-or-later；插件 SDK 和插件仓库采用 Apache-2.0。
zh-Hans.dl.title: 下载
zh-Hans.dl.lede: 请选择适合你系统的文件。每个版本的全部文件都列在它的发布页上。
zh-Hans.dl.note.installer: 仅为当前用户安装，无需管理员权限。安装包暂未代码签名：如果 Windows SmartScreen 发出警告，请点击更多信息 → 仍要运行。
zh-Hans.dl.note.portable: 解压到任意位置，运行 vestra-host.exe 即可，不会安装任何东西；SmartScreen 可能会像安装包一样发出警告。
zh-Hans.dl.note.dmg: 打开磁盘映像，把 Vestra Player 拖到“应用程序”文件夹。应用暂未经过公证：首次打开时 macOS 会阻止它，请打开系统设置 → 隐私与安全性，点击仍要打开。
zh-Hans.dl.fallback: 构建本页面时未能获取版本信息。发布页上有全部文件。
zh-Hans.dl.verify: 如需校验下载的文件，请将其 SHA-256 与此处的值对比：Windows 上运行 certutil -hashfile <文件> SHA256，macOS 上运行 shasum -a 256 <文件>。
zh-Hans.ft.licence: Vestra Player 采用 {player} 许可。插件 SDK 和插件仓库采用 {plugins} 许可。
zh-Hans.ft.privacy: 本站不使用 Cookie、统计分析或任何追踪器。你的语言选择只保存在你自己的浏览器中。
zh-Hans.ft.builtWith: 基于 libmpv、Slint 和 Node.js 构建。
